//: Type-checker configuration for the Control D Manager integration.
mypy is the gate that CI and the repo tooling run; Pylance reads this file so
the editor agrees with it instead of flagging idiomatic patterns as errors.
Only diagnostics that are genuinely wrong for this codebase are relaxed, and
each one names why rather than switching a mode off wholesale.
//reportUnusedParameter: The control tools are a template-method hierarchy: `_before`, `_after`,
signature in the base class and each subclass uses only the parts it needs.
An unused `hass` in one hook is the contract, not a defect.
//reportUnnecessaryIsInstance: The API payloads are untyped JSON, so runtime `isinstance` narrowing is how
they are validated; the narrowing is load-bearing even where the annotation
//reportMissingTypeStubs: `voluptuous as vol` and `probatio` ship no stubs, and the integration depends
on both. mypy already reports on these and passes.
//reportPrivateUsage: The test suite deliberately exercises protected hooks (`_undo`, `_before`,
`_registry`, `_service`) because those are the units under test, and the
contract audit script reads `_service` to compare tool and service schemas.
